frontier.name: CrystlQuant
frontier.blurb: One sports question a day. Make your call, see the crowd, keep your streak.

apps.name: Block Garden
apps.blurb: An 8 by 8 block puzzle where your score grows a garden. The pieces never rotate.

apps.name: Noodle Fury
apps.blurb: Stick on the left, fists on the right. Get Grandma's broth back before it goes cold.

apps.name: Pack It Perfect
apps.blurb: Rotate the camera, the books and the socks until the case is filled with no gaps.

apps.name: Pocket Sort
apps.blurb: Rockets, books, gems and plants. Four to a tray, and every tray one kind.

apps.name: Pocket Finds
apps.blurb: Six illustrated scenes, small details to find, no timer. Zoom in and take your time.

apps.name: Cable Tangle
apps.blurb: Drag the plugs until no two cables cross. Five plugs to start, twelve by the end.

apps.name: Nonogram Neighborhood
apps.blurb: Follow the number clues and fill the grid until a little pixel neighborhood appears.

apps.name: Cube Zoo
apps.blurb: Pair two cube animals, wait out the egg, and fill your grandmother's breeding notebook.

apps.name: Murder Jump
apps.blurb: Climb the rooftops, chase the lead, then name the culprit, motive, method and proof.

apps.name: Ms. Popular
apps.blurb: A texting dating sim. Five men, one channel, and a phone that never stops buzzing.

apps.name: Rich Man Poor Man
apps.blurb: One deck a day. Rich thing, poor thing, or both? Three minutes, and harder than it looks.

apps.name: Color Recall
apps.blurb: Name a famous thing, mix its color from memory, see how far off you really were.

apps.name: KPop Idol Trainee
apps.blurb: Twelve months, nine trainees, seven spots. Every text you send decides who debuts.

apps.name: Font Guesser
apps.blurb: A word in a typeface, four names. Daily Ten, Survival, and Font or Fake.

apps.name: Jurassic Pixel
apps.blurb: Pair two of a kind, check the odds, hatch the egg. 17 species, 85 colors to breed.

apps.name: Office Life
apps.blurb: Twelve weeks of probation at a startup. Your boss, your rival and the founder all text.

apps.name: What Year Was It?
apps.blurb: Five clues from one year, one at a time. Guess early for more points. New year daily.

apps.name: Korean Word a Day
apps.blurb: One Korean word a day. Read it, learn what it means, then build it from Hangul.

apps.name: Mr. Wonderful
apps.blurb: A rookie pro, five women, one tabloid and a phone that will not stop buzzing.

apps.name: Goal Machine
apps.blurb: Swipe to shoot, curl it past the wall, beat the keeper. 20 levels and a boss every fifth.

apps.name: Roommate Drama
apps.blurb: One flat, five people, twelve months of texts. Everyone remembers what you said.

apps.name: Pixel Pitch High
apps.blurb: One school year, a 3v3 match every Friday, and a scout who is not counting goals.

apps.name: Card Counter
apps.blurb: Learn real card counting in a city story. Six-deck blackjack, no real money.

apps.name: Young Homie
apps.blurb: A turn-based barrio RPG with timed hits, a crew of six, and a long memory.

apps.name: Domestique
apps.blurb: Ride for the leader, or become one. A pro cycling career from nobody to the Tour.

apps.name: Chess Drill Instructor
apps.blurb: A no-excuses drill sergeant that grinds your chess tactics sharp.

apps.name: Letterman
apps.blurb: Run the block by day, own the blacktop by night. Try not to wreck either.

apps.name: Murder Phone
apps.blurb: Crack open a murder victim's phone — and catch the killer hiding in the contacts.

apps.name: Sauce Boss
apps.blurb: Grow the pods, cook them down, bottle the heat. Build a hot-sauce empire.

apps.name: California Trail
apps.blurb: Oregon Trail, except the frontier is the 405 and the oxen are tires.

apps.name: Windward
apps.blurb: Buy low, sail far, sell high. Then set the standing orders and let the fleet run itself.

apps.name: Rug Pull: Crypto Tycoon
apps.blurb: Launch your own coin, then decide whether to make it real or run.

apps.name: Office Politics
apps.blurb: You are new here. Develop beef with your coworkers. Fight them for the title.

apps.name: Bare Knuckle
apps.blurb: No gloves, no rounds, no referee. Every punch costs the hand that threw it.

apps.name: Cabinet
apps.blurb: Fix dead arcade machines. Three tests, one guess, then flip the switch.

apps.name: Cell Block
apps.blurb: One day inside. Four choices. What you owe carries over, by name.

apps.name: Corner Store
apps.blurb: Order the stock. Open the doors. Watch the shift. A pixel art shop sim.

apps.name: Counter
apps.blurb: Haggle with heroes who need coin tonight. Three offers, then they walk out.

apps.name: Door Policy
apps.blurb: Bouncer on a basement door. Decide who gets in. Find out in the morning.

apps.name: Flip This Flat
apps.blurb: Buy a wreck, clear it out, furnish it and sell it on. One flat, three minutes.

apps.name: Front Page
apps.blurb: Write the headline. Print the paper. Readers, the law, the owner: pick one.

apps.name: Heel Turn
apps.blurb: Read the crowd, work the match, or steal the finish in a wrestling career RPG.

apps.name: Lemon Lot
apps.blurb: Every car on the lot has a story. You decide how much of it the buyer hears.

apps.name: Lost Property
apps.blurb: A sorting office, four bad descriptions a day. Find it, or say it is not here.

apps.name: Night Shift
apps.blurb: Eight bays, two nurses, and a ward that carries on whether you act or not.

apps.name: Rap Sheet
apps.blurb: A life simulator in text. One life, start to finish, every choice on it a crime.

apps.name: Reading Room
apps.blurb: Somebody sits down, says one thing, hides another. You decide what it means.

apps.name: Route
apps.blurb: Six machines, one van, one day. Restock the round and set a price.

apps.name: Scoop
apps.blurb: An ice cream shop on the beat. One rush, one queue, one ridiculous tower.

apps.name: Slumlord
apps.blurb: Buy the worst flats in town. Fix what you feel like. Hope nobody notices.

apps.name: Supply Run
apps.blurb: One bag, a meter that only goes up, and a door you can take at any time.

apps.name: The Fence
apps.blurb: Half your stock is stolen. The trick is knowing which half, and who is asking.

apps.name: The House
apps.blurb: The house always wins. You decide by how much, and who notices.

apps.name: The Yard
apps.blurb: Survive the sentence, fight smart, earn parole, or risk a prison-yard escape.

apps.name: Trace
apps.blurb: Crime scene cleaner, one room a night. Make it boring before six in the morning.

apps.name: Wrong Shift
apps.blurb: Six feeds, one building, one night. Name what changed, or log all clear.

apps.name: Bent FC
apps.blurb: Bribe, dope and fix your way from the Sunday Gutter League to continental glory.

apps.name: DORK
apps.blurb: A text adventure you play entirely by ear — LOOK doesn't work here.

apps.name: Mise
apps.blurb: Import any recipe, then cook it step by step with the timers run for you.

apps.name: Marathon Legend
apps.blurb: Train a scrappy street kid into a marathon champion.

apps.name: Stonewheel
apps.blurb: Skate sick lines, dodge chores, and beat Chad Bradley to all ten wrestling figures.

apps.name: Cage of Glory
apps.blurb: Claw your way from club shows to the MMA title belt.

apps.name: Bikini Bay
apps.blurb: Build a surf camp, shape the boards, and take your team to a world title.

apps.name: Bleacher Busters
apps.blurb: Swipe to swing. Launch baseballs into orbit. 30 days to out-hit your rivals.

apps.name: Wall Street: 1987
apps.blurb: Turn a $5,000 loan into a Wall Street empire — before the SEC catches up.

apps.name: Zero-Day Syndicate
apps.blurb: Run a hacker crew. Hire the talent, build the exploits, keep the heat off.

apps.name: Water Polo Smash
apps.blurb: Drag back, load the spin, and bend the ball past the keeper.

apps.name: Crystl: Supplements and Fasting
apps.blurb: Track what you actually take, and what it is doing to your biological age.

apps.name: Bent FC: Tournament Edition
apps.blurb: Bribe a whole nation into a tournament it has no business attending.

apps.name: Afterhours Cafe
apps.blurb: Lay out the floor, write the menu, learn the regulars. A cafe that opens after dark.

apps.name: Canopy Disc Golf
apps.blurb: Read the breeze, set the power, and curve a disc through the trees into the basket.

apps.name: Clean Beans
apps.blurb: Coffee out front, washers out back. Nothing dirty in sight when the inspector walks in.

apps.name: Mochi Stack
apps.blurb: Tap to drop a squishy cube pet onto the tower. Land it dead center for a PERFECT.

apps.name: Penguin Slide
apps.blurb: Tap to turn at every corner of a twisty ice path. Miss one and it is into the snow.

apps.name: Puff
apps.blurb: Hold to puff up and float, let go to sink. Slip a tiny fish through the coral.

apps.name: Solitaire Postcards
apps.blurb: Draw-one Klondike across illustrated destinations. The daily deal always has a solution.

apps.name: Switchback Post
apps.blurb: Ski the parcel downhill through the right gates and reach the cabin with the seal intact.

apps.name: Theme Studio
apps.blurb: Original wallpapers, matching color palettes and a home-screen date widget.

apps.name: Arc & Arrow
apps.blurb: Read the wind, wait for the breath, let go. Target archery over 48 challenges.

apps.name: Boltwork
apps.blurb: Lift the screws, drop the plates, take the machine apart. 120 solvable boards.

apps.name: Carat
apps.blurb: Drag gem pieces onto an 8x8 velvet board. Fill a line and it shatters.

apps.name: Kittycat
apps.blurb: Bring home a shy cat and earn their trust, one small day at a time.

apps.name: Last Lantern
apps.blurb: Tap left or right to parry. Wait out the breath, ignore the feints, keep the light on.

apps.name: Monkey Swing
apps.blurb: Hold to grab a vine, let go to fly. See how far one cube monkey can swing.

apps.name: Keepy Kitty
apps.blurb: Tap so the kitten hops and boops the balloon with her nose. Keep it off the grass.

apps.name: Tile Trails
apps.blurb: Mahjong solitaire along a trail of quiet gardens. Match free pairs, open the layers.

apps.name: Word Search Routes
apps.blurb: Eight words per grid, twelve themes, and a new route through the letters every day.

apps.name: Ashline Ronin
apps.blurb: Read the attack, time the parry, answer with a counter. Anime sword duels.

apps.name: Brambleguard
apps.blurb: Survive the waves, stack the upgrades, build a new knight every run.

apps.name: Mic Drop
apps.blurb: Rap battle meets deckbuilding. Chain rhymes, drop bars, save the station.

apps.name: Tumbler
apps.blurb: Pick 100 locks, crack bank vaults and clear your father's name.

apps.name: Cagebound
apps.blurb: An MMA deckbuilder where every card is a technique. Read the fight, save the gym.

apps.name: Scrubbed
apps.blurb: Clean up crime scenes the police closed, and find what they missed.

apps.name: Prism Post
apps.blurb: Restore stained-glass windows, deliver lost letters and color your own story.

apps.name: Blue Hour
apps.blurb: A cozy reef adventure: photograph wildlife and finish a family journal.

apps.name: Blush Hour
apps.blurb: Paint real makeup on 3D faces and save your aunt's salon in ten weeks.

apps.name: Twistworld
apps.blurb: A tiny kingdom lives on a cube. Twist it back together, or speed-solve.

apps.name: Window Seat
apps.blurb: Ride scenic trains, ferries and buses, and photograph what flashes past your window.

apps.name: Red Thread
apps.blurb: Chase a master thief across 40 cities. Read the clues, make the arrest.

apps.name: Brake Point
apps.blurb: Master racing lines, perfect braking and spotting hazards before they happen.

apps.name: Night Signal
apps.blurb: Learn real Morse code as a 1962 radio operator guiding ships through storms.

apps.name: Boxcar Blitz
apps.blurb: Surf the boxcars and outrun Big Brick in an endless rail yard dash.

apps.name: Queen Bea
apps.blurb: Match, blast and restore a royal castle room by room. Save Queen Bea!

apps.name: Bonbon Valley
apps.blurb: Swap and blast candies across 300 levels to win back a sugar-frosted valley.

apps.name: High Note
apps.blurb: Hold to sing higher, let go to drop. Ride the melody down a neon coast road.

apps.name: Debut
apps.blurb: 52 weeks. Eight trainees. One shot at Rookie of the Year.

apps.name: Last Encore
apps.blurb: Every step on the beat. Fight down six floors of the Underworld to win back a stolen voice.

apps.name: Tour Van
apps.blurb: One van, four bandmates, 30 days to reach the biggest festival on the coast.

apps.name: Method
apps.blurb: From background extra to award winner. Read the scene, hit the emotion, own the take.

apps.name: Samba Notes
apps.blurb: Match music notes, write the samba and bring a broke samba school back to Carnaval.

apps.name: Stunt Double
apps.blurb: Launch, flip, crash and land the director's money shot. The star takes the credit.

apps.name: Red Carpet Rush
apps.blurb: Your limo is gone and the paparazzi are everywhere. Run to your premiere.

apps.name: Neon Strip
apps.blurb: Rebuild a dead neon strip club by club, then headline it yourself.
